meaning: Our research priorities inspired by public evidence, not assertions of anyone's private plans. No priority number is a probability.

hypotheses.title: Residual-bank compression under explicit hardware and quality budgets
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Low-error approximation with lower persistent storage at multiple depth/distribution settings, followed by matched-budget training and measured GPU memory.
hypotheses.falsifier: Rare-information loss, training regression, or dequantization/backward/communication costs erase the practical benefit.
hypotheses.next_gate: Real activation traces and matched token/time small-model training; separately validate serial/CP forward and gradient parity, state-layout tuning and reference scaling on supported hardware before counting practical gains. Maintainer branch commits are not our training result; no GPU spending authorized or performed.

hypotheses.title: Versioned context and durable agent completion contracts
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Independent SQLite traces distinguish preserved rows, false-clean diagnostics and unresolved work. The merged pi adapter primitive additionally completes queued writes after abort, allows a subsequent transaction, and rejects expired handles in six deterministic Node SQLite traces. Direct host writes can be rolled back with the active transaction. Full pi storage and Cloudflare runtime were not executed. OpenClaw recovery/repair is now merged at 275c611e with the previously read PR head unchanged. Upstream CI job status is verified, but synthetic unit fixtures do not establish old-release upgrade or persistent task completion.
hypotheses.falsifier: A real harness already covers these contracts or does not exhibit the relevant failure; assumptions fail under concurrent writers, torn storage or external effects.
hypotheses.next_gate: Generate an actual old-release state fixture and run accepted Doctor repair through its real locked-SQLite maintenance owner, including backup, exact-row compare-and-apply, reopen, concurrent owners and persistent task progress. For grading/collection, observe real close-managed service lifetime and stopped-path negative controls in a supported harness. Surrogate callbacks and bounded promise settlement do not satisfy these gates.

hypotheses.title: Adaptive evaluation bias in automated research
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Increasing public-feedback search budget inflates selected validation scores while sealed holdout fails to match.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent holdout matches selected gains after budget and multiple-comparison controls.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fixed candidate budget, one-shot hidden evaluation, multiple seeds; do not rebrand existing sealed evaluation as our invention.

hypotheses.title: Reward and environment-version consistency in agentic RL
hypotheses.supporting_observation: A versioned failure ledger exposes reward inconsistencies hidden by retries or final-success-only reporting.
hypotheses.falsifier: Repeated deterministic scoring and perturbation tests find no consequential inconsistencies.
hypotheses.next_gate: Execute supported real harness scoring with normal/inter-segment versus timeout/stopped, same-box versus isolated grading, real close-managed process/HTTP-service lifetime and independent final scoring. Also test the unmerged unified error-history timeout/ok contract. Neither PR has been executed here; fake cleanup callbacks are insufficient.
